subject: English
passage: Building on earlier theoretical work by Einstein, physicists Rainer Weiss, Barry Barish, and Kip Thorne—winners of the 2017 Nobel Prize in Physics—developed and then modified the sophisticated laser interferometry systems of the LIGO gravitational wave detectors ______ an instrument that has transformed our understanding of cosmic phenomena.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The convention being tested is the use of finite and nonfinite verb forms within a sentence. The nonfinite to-infinitive "to create" is correctly used to form a nonfinite (infinitive) clause that explains why the physicists developed and modified the LIGO detectors.
